Okay, attack!
...Huh? What are {{drive_a}}, B, C?

Once you {{medachange}}, you can't
use your original head and arm {{part|pl}}.

Instead you get three {{medachange}}
commands, the <c:ff00ff>Drives<c>.

Drives have no usage limit, but each
use costs <c:ff00ff>10%<c> of the {{charge_gauge}}.

Note: charging during {{medachange}}
won't fill the {{charge_gauge}}.

In return, many Drives are powerful,
so they can turn a {{robattle}} your way.

You can also pick {{medachange}} with $ｷ
to <c:ff00ff>end the transformation<c> yourself.

That's all. Use {{medachange}} well
and show me you can win this {{robattle}}.
